name: ThirdShotHub Sideline Backpack 32L
description: The ThirdShotHub Sideline Backpack 32L carries a full league kit without a separate shoe bag. Two fleece-lined paddle sleeves sit against the back panel where they stay flat, a ventilated base compartment takes a size 13 shoe, and an insulated side pocket holds a 32 oz bottle upright. The frame sheet is stiff enough that the pack stands on its own on a wet court surround instead of slumping into a puddle.

specifications.paddle_sleeves: 2, fleece-lined, fits elongated paddles to 16.5 in
specifications.shoe_compartment: Ventilated base, fits to US size 13
specifications.fabric: 600D recycled polyester with 1500 mm PU coating
specifications.dimensions: 20 in H x 13 in W x 9 in D

care_instructions: Spot clean with mild soap and cool water; do not machine wash, which delaminates the PU coating that keeps the base water-resistant. Empty the ventilated shoe compartment after every session — trapped damp is what eventually rots the mesh. Lubricate the main zipper twice a season with a wax-based zipper stick. The 3-year warranty covers zipper and seam failure, not abrasion from dragging the base.
